propositions: Snapshot store garbage collection runs only in the review-bot process; every other host that resolves attested gates (developer laptops, CI runners, library embeddings) populates the store and never reclaims it, causing unbounded growth
The operation-linked GC trigger must avoid long-lock pitfalls by using a near-free O(1) in-process check on the gate-resolution tail with the heavy GC pass running detached in a child process
The trigger decision must not hold the ticket-store lock, never raise into the gate operation, and must perform no store enumeration—only a stat of a timestamp marker

Single-flight enforcement via stamped worker.lock sidecar and run_gc's existing flock prevents double-running; overlap with the review-bot's resident janitor degrades gracefully to skipped="locked" without regressing the resident thread

The GC trigger is operation-linked and in-process with no dependency on CI providers, cron, or daemons; all worktrees on a host share one clock and lock because sidecars are keyed on the per-host snapshot store root
